test_title: PYST 3: Selection Post (Graduate Level) - General Intelligence (Held On 26 Jul, 2025 Shift 3)
subject: reasoning
question: Each question has four options. Three of them go together based on a common idea or rule. One is different. Identify the one that is different.
solution:
Result = -2 (Not a prime number, as primes must be greater than 1)

(1) 3 - 5 → Both numbers are odd/ prime numbers.

(2) 5 - 3 → Both numbers are odd/ prime numbers.

**(3) 6 - 2 → Both numbers are Even/ composite numbers.**

(4) 7 - 3 → Both numbers are odd/ prime numbers.

Hence, the correct answer is “**Option 3**”.
